title: Human-approved HPCI lifecycle, operations, and TCO evidence update
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's instruction to continue the prioritized OpenFS work. Add provider-published HPCI system commissioning and operational evidence, distinguish observed starts from future refresh targets, and add a complete five-year TCO scope audit without inferring component prices or treating known contractual floors as complete TCO. Keep all research provisional and Consensus-incomplete. Validate, push, and create a bilingual reviewable pull request. Do not merge or deploy production GitHub Pages without a separate explicit instruction.
